title: Projection from a geometrically connected factor induces a bijection on connected components
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter varieties.tex, section on geometrically connected schemes
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that if X is geometrically connected over k then the projection X x_k Y -> Y induces a bijection between connected components (statement lines 733-740). The proof assembles three separate facts about the projection: that its fibres are connected, because they are base changes of a geometrically connected scheme along field extensions; that the scheme theoretic fibres may be replaced by set theoretic ones; and that the map is open, which follows from a general result on morphisms of schemes over a field (proof lines 744-751). Only then does the topological criterion on connected fibres apply. The claim is H2: no construction, but a correct order of three cited inputs, and the openness step is the one that would be missed by a reader thinking only about fibres.
